remarks:
Build Your Dream Home Just Steps from Lake Ontario! A fantastic opportunity to build a year-round residence or second home in a desirable Lake Ontario community! This spacious parcel offers deeded lake rights, giving homeowners access to the community picnic area and beach—perfect for enjoying summer days by the water. The HOA fee is only $55 per year, helping maintain the community beach and picnic areas. Property Highlights are Lake Ontario access through deeded lake rights, Community beach and picnic area. Property consist of Frontage on Three Roads: 107 feet on Sunset Beach Rd — maintained by the Town. 149 feet on Fairview Dr. — private road. 70 feet on Vinecliffe Dr. — private road. Public water available at the street. Private well already on the property. Existing storage shed. Septic system required.
Minimum 800 sq. ft. single-family home. Cable, electric, water, and telephone available. With frontage on three roads and convenient access to Lake Ontario, this property offers plenty of possibilities for creating your own getaway or year-round home. Bring your plans and start building your Lake Ontario retreat!
